name: Technology & Gadgets
equipment: A notebook and a partner (or mirror) to practice speaking aloud
instructions: This lesson focuses on technology & gadgets — practice these key phrases out loud:
My phone battery drains so fast these days.
Have you tried restarting the app?
I need to update my software before the meeting.
This new laptop is so much faster than my old one.
Try using at least three of these phrases in a short role-play conversation with a partner (or out loud to yourself).
